description: LspTool contract for bd-cv653.1.1 and bd-cv653.8.1: hermetic status discovery, cache-only glob diagnostics, and named action validation without spawning a language server.

cases.name: lsp_status_lists_configured_servers_without_spawning
cases.description: status is a hermetic happy path that exposes configured defaults while leaving the live registry empty

cases.name: lsp_glob_diagnostics_use_only_the_empty_cache
cases.description: glob diagnostics are answered from the live-server cache and therefore never spawn a server

cases.name: lsp_rejects_unknown_actions_with_the_stable_taxonomy
cases.description: an unsupported action is a named usage result and enumerates the supported contract
